# Nathan Renting — nathanrenting.dev

> Solo developer from Eindhoven, Netherlands. Builds AI agent systems (LLM orchestration, tool-calling, RAG) and real-time audio engines. Available for freelance contract work, 2–3 days per week, EU remote.

## Identity

- **Full name:** Jonathan David Renting (professionally goes by Nathan Renting)
- **Location:** Eindhoven, Noord-Brabant, Netherlands
- **Trade:** Freelance / ZZP, KvK-registered
- **Contact:** info@nathanrenting.dev
- **Indicative rate:** €110–130 per hour (project pricing available)

## Expertise

- **AI agents:** LLM orchestration, tool-calling, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Claude API, MCP (Model Context Protocol), LangGraph, FastAPI
- **Real-time audio:** native Rust audio engines, DSP, Android NDK, React Native FFI bridges, browser-side audio (Web Audio API, WASM)
- **Stack:** TypeScript, Rust, Python, Next.js, React Native, Kotlin, Tailwind, Supabase, Vercel

## Featured projects

- [AudioLaunch](https://nathanrenting.dev/projects/audiolaunch): a mobile music-creation app (Studio DAW + Resonara) built on a native Rust audio engine — live in public open beta at audio-launch.com
- [AudioLab.tools](https://nathanrenting.dev/projects/audiolab): a public browser-side audio toolkit at audiolab.tools (live)
- [Echo](https://nathanrenting.dev/projects/echo): AI agent orchestration system with multi-step planning
- [TherapyVault](https://nathanrenting.dev/projects/therapyvault): secure session vault and notes for therapists
- [CaptionCompass](https://nathanrenting.dev/projects/captioncompass): AI captioning workflow for podcasters and creators
- [PhotoFlow](https://nathanrenting.dev/projects/photoflow): workflow automation for photographers
- [FamilyKart](https://nathanrenting.dev/projects/familykart): household coordination app
